name: MonarchCollapsible
title: Collapsible
summary: One section whose header shows and hides its content, with the TalkBack expand and collapse actions.
whenToUse: For one block of secondary content that most people do not need: advanced settings, details, the evidence behind a figure.
whenNotToUse: For several sections of a page where one opens at a time use an accordion. For a choice that changes a setting use MonarchSwitchRow.
api: @Composable fun MonarchCollapsible(expanded: Boolean, onExpandedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, expandedLabel: String? = null, collapsedLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchCollapsible(expanded: Boolean, onExpandedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, header: @Composable RowScope.() -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, heading: Boolean = false, trailingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, expandedLabel: String? = null, collapsedLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called with the new state when the header is activated.

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label of the header; name the content.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the header responds. The content keeps its current state.

options.name: trailingIcon
options.description: An icon after the label, such as a chevron; it turns half a turn while expanded.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the press, focus and hover interactions of the header.

options.name: content
options.description: The content that is shown and hidden.

options.name: heading
options.description: Marks the header as a heading for TalkBack navigation.

options.name: header
options.description: Custom header content, still one button with the state.

states.name: expanded
states.description: The content is shown under the header and the trailing icon is turned half a turn.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The label and the icon use the disabled text color and the header does not respond.

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring around the header.

appearance: The header label uses the default text color and the icon the muted text color, both the disabled text color when disabled, with the label type role. The pressed state is the Material ripple. The content takes the colors of what is put in it.
platformNotes: The web Collapsible has separate root, trigger and content parts, an optional chevron and an asChild trigger, and keeps closed content mounted. Android has one composable with a full-width header row and a label string; the chevron is the trailingIcon slot because Monarch bundles no icons. Closed content leaves the composition, as on iOS, so state inside it is lost unless the app hoists it. iOS styles the system DisclosureGroup instead; Android has no such component, so Monarch builds it.
accessibility: The header is one TalkBack element with the button role, the label and the state "Expanded" or "Collapsed".
TalkBack offers the expand action while collapsed and the collapse action while expanded.
A disabled header is announced as disabled and offers neither action.
Hidden content is not in the composition, so TalkBack does not reach it.
The header is at least 48dp high and the whole row responds to touch.
The content appears without animation when the user has turned animations off.
The trailing icon is decoration; give it a null content description.
edgeCases: A long label wraps; the icon stays centered on it.
Content that starts expanded is not animated in.
State inside the content, such as a text field's value, is lost when it closes unless the app holds it.
